authorReviewNote: Iceberg floatingice brokenfromglacier/iceshelf, notthinseaice/permafrost/snowdrift. Cambridge floatingice alone insufficient for origin, actual NOAA icebergdefinition inspected instead. Large avoids smallerbergybits/growlers, no saltwaterfreezing origin mistake. Openwater includes appropriate lakes as well as sea.

Permafrost ground at/below0C for2consecutiveyears, notseasonalsnow/seasonalseaice/nonmovingglacier. NSIDC actual frozen-ground definition and temperature-only criterion inspected. Replaced vague permanentlyfrozen dictionary shorthand, includes dryrock with littleice. DegreeC UTF8 correct.

Tundra coldlargelytreeless lowplants, notpalm-desert/tropicalforest/coralreef. Actual NPS arctic/subarctic ecology states lowplants and treeless; Alpine NPS definition corroborates coldtreelesszone. Avoided claiming everytundra has permanentpermafrost merely because narrowdictionary definition saidso.

Taiga borealforest, nottropicalrainforest/saltmarsh/equatorialdesert. NPS actual Boreal region also-known-taiga paragraph inspected, Cambridge northernconifers corroborates. Not everytree evergreen because larchdeciduousconifers exist, and no alltaigawaterlogged claim.

Savanna grassland/scatteredtrees, notclosedforest/polaricesheet/bareseafloor. Actual Cambridge noun grass/fewtrees definition inspected. Did not repeat dictionary's overly narrow mostoaks as universal, and no tropical-only assertion excludes temperate savannas. Core vegetationstructure correct.

Temperaterainforestsexist beyondtropics. Actual NPS Smokies page defines coolmidlatitude rainforest, unlike tropicalcounterpart. Cambridge tropical-only entry insufficient and replaced. Otherchoices allrainforests equator/tropics/greenhouse false. No currentrainfall or plantcount memorisation.

Steppe broadlargelytreeless temperategrassland, nottropicalforest/reef/fjord. Actual Cambridge geographic grassland/Eurasianregion definition inspected. Temperate generallylocates classicsteppe, no claim everygrass absenttree alwayssteppe or neverdry. Existing Ukrainian landscape question tests place, not termdefinition.

Wetland watercover/saturation persists enough for adaptedvegetation, notmerelyanybriefpuddle. Actual EPA wetland definition and soil/plant/hydrology explanation inspected. Added duration/vegetationprecision to original vague part-time water answer. Otherdesert/snowline/bareplateau descriptions not wetlanddefinition. Generalecological fact, no permittingadvice.

Karst soluble-rock dissolution by water, notwinddune/lavaplain/seaice. USGS actual teacher-guide karsttopography dissolution paragraph inspected, beyond dictionary wornaway wording. No limestone-only restriction excludes dolomite/gypsumkarst. Correct process not physicalerosion synonym.

Sinkhole groundsubsides/collapses into spacebelow, notdune/atoll/cape. Actual Cambridge unsupportedground/hole geological sense inspected, ignored cybersinkhole verb/server definition. Does not assert everyhole limestone or natural, permitting subsidence from severalcauses. Clear morphology.

Geothermalgeyser erupts hotwater/steam, notfreezingground/riverundersea/coralreef. Actual Cambridge naturalgeyser scheduledwater/steam definition checked, ignored olddomesticheater sense. Geothermal qualifier excludes coldCO2-driven features also colloquially calledgeysers. Doesn't claim identical eruptionintervals.

Escarpment longsteepslope/cliff betweenheights, notlagoon/oxbow/islandgroup. Actual Cambridge landform definition and American continuousrocksteepside sense inspected. Replaced hotspring-heat question which overlapped geothermalenergysource. Not wholeplateau definition, specifically steepedge.

Continental shelf shallow submergedcontinentalmargin, notdeeptrench/inlandmountains/floatingice. Actual Cambridge seafloor-nearcontinent-shallowwater definition inspected. No exactdepth universalcutoff or claim shelfalwaysflat. Clear landform type.

Drainagedivide separates neighbouringbasins, notriverhalves/species/waterfalllevels. Actual USGS HUC glossary explicitly watershed-boundaryline and separatecatchments, inspected. Replaced ambiguous Cambridge watershed regionalmeanings/TVsense asreference, not applied those alternate senses.

Drainagebasin land drained byriver/tributaries, notdeepestpool/oxbow/damwall. USGS actual RiverBasin definition plus Cambridge catchmentdefinition checked. Wholelandarea rather than containerinriver. Doesn't require particularbasinsize or politicalborder.

Urbanisation demographic riseurbanpopulationshare, notruralshare/age/birthrate. UN actual definition discussion distinguishes urbanabsoluteincrease from proportion, inspected. Reworded as demographicdefinition; oldpublication used only stableconcept, no stalepopulationstatistics. Replaced distractors about removingroads/allforest with comparabledemographicmetrics.

Suburb outlyingurban district oftenresidential, notnecessarilyhistoriccentre/isthmus/craterlake. Cambridge actual edge/outsidecity/home-and-smallbusiness definitions inspected. Often avoids exclusivelyhousing claim, and no requirement politicallyindependentmunicipality. Straight grammar.

Density population perarea, nottime/height/income. Actual Cambridge fixedarea measurement definition inspected; people context narrows generalpopulation not animal-only claim. No unstablecityrank/statistic used. Unitofarea genericallows squarekilometres or miles, soleofferedcorrectdenominator.

Landlocked no coastwithopenseaaccess, notbelowsealevel/allislands/noinlandwater. Actual Cambridge surroundedbyland/nocoast definition checked. Open-sea wording handles Caspian closed-inlandsea countries, not denies rivers/inlandlakes or shippingvia rivers. Existing specificlandlockedcountry questions distinct from definition.

Sea-landreclamation makesusableland fromwatercoveredarea, notwaveerosion/fasterupstream/movingmountain. Actual Cambridge reclamation Businessland-underwater definition inspected; empty land-reclamation URL replaced. Fromthesea qualifier distinguishes mine/brownfieldrestoration and recycling meanings. No environmentalbenefit claim.

Coastline onmap traceslandedge-seashape, notnationaldesertborder/ridge/rivercentre. Actual Cambridge coastline shape-seenonmap meaning inspected. Replaced olderosiondefinition duplicated inScience. Reworded to exactshape sense, avoids legal/tidal-boundaryprecision implication.

Rivermouth dischargesintosea/lake/largerriver. USGS actual WaterResources glossary definition inspected; generic humanmouth sense and sea-only dictionaryshorthand notused. Replaced oldweatheringdefinition duplicatedinScience. Otherbasinhighpoint/bendcentre/damdeepestpoint not outletdefinition.

Waterdeposited sand/silt example sediment, notheat/direction/speed. Actual Cambridge noun solidmatter settlinginliquid and sand/stoneslayer definitions inspected. Examples not exhaustive, so wind/ice sediments stillallowed. Distinct from oldsedimentaryrock-formingprocess question.

Geothermal energy internalEarthheat, notwind/sun/tidalpullalone. Actual Cambridge geothermal definition insideEarthheat inspected. No claim allrenewableenergy geothermal or powerplant has nocost/emissions. New accessible earth-energyconcept in physicalgeography.

Waterreservoir storeswater, notwindspeed/seismicrecord/countryborder. Actual Cambridge waterstoragelake naturalorartificial definitions inspected. Doesn't mandate everyreservoir dammade or drinkablewater, and no conflict with pen-inkreservoir term in Hobbies. Literal water-supply scope.
